meta.home: A mobile action game. Ride the creases between worlds, seal the Rifts, bring down the Tyrants.
meta.fold: The story of Dimension Riders: the Fold, the Amber, the Unfolded, the Riders and the Seal.
meta.download: Download Dimension Riders for Android, free and offline.
meta.privacy: Dimension Riders privacy policy: no data collected, works offline.

hero.tagline: Cross worlds. Bring down the Tyrants. Seal the Rifts.
hero.opening: The worlds lie apart, like layers of folded paper. The Tyrants found a way to tear through that paper and invade the other side. You are a Rider. Cross worlds, fight the invaders and seal the Rifts before they grow. Your Shard is already pulling. Another world needs your help.

ride.title: Ride the creases
ride.text: Every Rift opens onto a crease between two worlds. Ride it with twin-stick controls: one thumb moves, the other aims and fires.

seal.title: Seal the Rifts
seal.text: Fight waves of invaders and reach the exit to seal the Rift. Every closed passage cuts off a route for the invasion.

tyrants.title: Bring down the Tyrants
tyrants.text: Fight through the invasion outposts to reach the layer’s Tyrant. Bring down the leader, defeat the defenders and close the passage they sustain.

cta.title: Your Shard is pulling.
cta.text: Free. Offline. No ads, no accounts.

download.title: Download
download.intro: Dimension Riders is free, works offline, and has no ads or accounts.
download.storeSoon: The Google Play listing is coming soon. Until then, install the APK below.
download.storeReady: The easiest way: install from Google Play and get updates automatically.
download.step1: Download the APK with the button above.
download.step2: Open the file. Android will ask you to allow installs from this source. Allow it once.
download.step3: Tap Install. To update later, download the new APK and install it over the old one.
